[[High Inquisitor]] [[Halmere]] wielded a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during the reign of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
[[File:Inquisitortraining.jpg|left|thumb|Halmere training with the other Inquisitors.]]
[[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] Halmere wielded the lightsaber in a training session with fellow Inquisitors [[Antinnis Tremayne]], [[Lanu Pasiq]], and [[Gwellib Ap-Llewff]], while the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] oversaw the session. Inquisitor Tremayne very quickly overwhelmed him and the other Inquisitors by disarming them of their lightsabers and wielding all four blades at once.<ref name="EAR" />
